result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's `*Scoping*` tests pass. I didn't add new tests for the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` or `build-gradle.js` cases, so those fixes are unchecked beyond reading the patterns.

- **HTML generators:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file named exactly `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. The content patterns are unchanged, so an ordinary `.xml` or `.js` file without those lines stays out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. `.*[.]gradle`, which covers `build.gradle`, is untouched.

I didn't commit anything.
